responsibility: Implements 32-bit PowerPC ABI classification, including Linux-specific preservation of ZST arguments, aggregate indirect passing, and 32-bit integer extension for scalar arguments and returns.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `asm/powerpc.rs`, this file is concerned only with 32-bit PowerPC function ABI lowering, including Linux ZST treatment and aggregate indirect passing, not inline-assembly register classes or clobberable registers.
